title: 15 cops among 21 martyred in blast at Kohat Police Lines, more than 80 injured

article.title: 15 cops among 21 martyred in blast at Kohat Police Lines, more than 80 injured
article.summary: PESHAWAR: At least 21 people, including 15 police officials, were martyred on Friday when an explosives-laden vehicle detonated near a mosque in Kohat Police Lines, followed by terrorists storming the compound and attacking police facilities, according to senior police and district health officials. District Health Officer Dr Nasir Hassan Afridi confirmed the toll to Dawn , adding that more than 100 people were injured, with three in critical condition. According to officials, SP Traffic Akbar Shinwari and Dr Israel Orakzai, head of the children’s department at DHQ KDA Kohat, were among those martyred in the attack. Police said at least one attacker was holed up inside the compound and a clearance operation was underway. In a separate statement, the CTD said the Additional IG CTD reached the site of the Kohat attack. An exchange of fire between CTD personnel and the terrorist was ongoing, the department said, adding that the AIG had entered the police lines to take part in the operation and lead the personnel.
